pretreatments.description: Electrohydrolysis pretreatment applied to Pulps and Paper Mill Sludge (PPMS) using direct current (DC) to solubilize organic matter through electrophoresis, ohmic heating, and electroosmosis. Specific conditions included varying applied voltage (15 V) and time duration (45 min) to optimize solubilization rate and hydrolysis step for anaerobic digestion.
